content.text:
STOP BEFORE CREATING MORE FILES.


The current AIInstance implementation has architectural problems.


Do not continue from this design.


AIInstance must not directly contain arbitrary dictionaries for identity, personality, user preferences, model configuration, and memory.


Re-evaluate the domain boundaries from the source-of-truth documentation.


Specifically:


Separate AI identity from user identity/preferences.
Do not place user identity preference inside the AI identity object.
Do not make the model configuration part of the AI's identity state.
Do not put persistence logic inside the domain model.
Do not use a giant dictionary-based AIInstance as a substitute for the documented architecture.


Before writing more code, inspect the current ai_instance.py and correct it in place.


The AI instance may be an aggregate/root object if the documentation supports that, but its concepts must remain architecturally separated.


Implement only the domain boundaries actually required by the documentation.


Do not delete the entire project again.


Fix the current architectural mistake and continue.
